CustomField.description: REV-60: TRUE when this line's product is managed by the ALM Promo/Dispatch engine (ALMPromoDispatchEngine), i.e. its ProductCode is one of the codes in ALM_Code_Engine_Settings__mdt.Control.ALM_Product_Codes__c. Used ONLY by the CPQ product rule "Promo Code Required - Non bundle products" so that rule fires on Division=ALM products OUTSIDE engine scope (TXOM/DRGM/CCAM/DBRM/DDEM/NLOM/CTOM/LARM/BAOM/MLOM...) and never re-collides with the engine on in-scope codes (the engine auto-fills those AFTER save, so a save-time rule would block them). KEEP IN SYNC with ALM_Product_Codes__c — a formula cannot read Custom Metadata, so this list is a deliberate mirror. Adding a product to the engine WITHOUT adding it here would make the rule block saves on a code the engine fills.
CustomField.formula: OR( SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LAWM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LWKM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "GLBM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "GLBM - Team Membership", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "GLBM - Individual Membership", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "NYLM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "NYOM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "Law.com Pro", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "PCEM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LNVM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LGCM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LGLM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "LRCM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "VSCM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "WEB", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "TIOM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "DROM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "RCOM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "TALM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "ALLM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "CHLM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "DBOM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "NJOM", SBQQ__ProductCode__c = "NJLM" )
CustomField.label: Engine Scoped Promo
